snippet.title: Float Your Goat Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Float Your Goat now has a demo! 

Make strange and wonderous rafts and set sail across the seas while keeping a goat and his friends safe and most importantly: dry.

You can play it here for free:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4139630/Float_Your_Goat_Demo/
